faqs.q: What options are available for recording driving experience?
faqs.a: You can choose to use a paper log book or the Roundtrip log book app.

faqs.q: What does the Roundtrip log book app help with?
faqs.a: The app helps you record and update your driving hours, calculate your progress towards 120 driving hours, and ensure you have completed the 20 learning goals.

faqs.q: What happens if I use a discontinued log book app?
faqs.a: Service centres cannot retrieve or transfer your recorded hours to your paper log book if you did not enter your NSW Driver Licence in the Licence Ready app or L2P app, or entered an incorrect number. If you are using hours logged in the Licence Ready app or L2P app, arrive at the service centre at least 1 hour prior to your driving test to retrieve and transfer your hours to a paper log book.
